changed.item: "plainly earned" became "honestly earned", which hints that the City money was dishonest rather than just less direct or tangible
"worked the lock" became "fiddled with the lock", which makes the narrator sound less skilled and more haphazard
"When it turned" (the lock turning) became "The door opened", a slightly different event

added.item: "Standing there" places the realisation on the doorstep at that moment; the original doesn't say where or when it happened
